g.text: Applies to newly drawn wires. Existing wires keep whatever they were drawn with. Nudge steps stay 1 mil / 5 mil — those
are bonder-process quantities, not display settings.
Wire z-height is where BOTH feet of a new wire land — a wire drawn in the layout view, and the wire a new wBond
component is created with. The profile view is unaffected: there you click the height you want.
Paste pitch places a pasted wire clear of what is already there, stepping in +y until it lands free. It never re-spaces the
circuitRF's built-in assembly rule: how close two wires may pass, measured surface to surface between their outer edges.
Reported as an error by a design-rule check, whether or not a .wasm assembly rule file is referenced — a house's rule file
is not what makes overlapping metal invalid. Zero reports only wires that actually touch or overlap. A .wasm's own spacing
rules are checked as well as this one, never instead of it.
